card.text: The Dumbbell Nebula is a planetary nebula about 388 parsecs away.

sources.label: Chornay & Walton (2021), A&A 656, A110; CDS J/A+A/656/A110, Table A.1, PN G060.8-03.6: distance 388 pc (382 to 394) from the Gaia EDR3 parallax of its central star

sources.quote: The Dumbbell Nebula is a planetary nebula in the constellation Vulpecula, at a distance of about 1360 light-years.

introduction.text: NOIRLab's photograph of it stands here as a flat picture facing the Sun, 1.00 pc wide.

sources.quote: It was the first such nebula to be discovered, by Charles Messier in 1764.
